recentItems.title: Rescuer Shares Update from Frontlines of Disaster Site as 'Swamp-like Mud' Poses Biggest Challenge
recentItems.description:
A member of a Chinese rescue team working on the frontlines following August 26's deadly mudslide at the China-Nepal border has shared an update from the scene, describing the challenges posed by the "swamp-like mud" and difficult weather conditions as emergency work continues.

recentItems.title: Rescuers Battle Waist-Deep Mud to Search for Missing After Fatal Mudslide in China's Xizang
recentItems.description:
Rescue teams are battling waist-deep mud and treacherous terrain in a race against time to search for survivors following a devastating mudslide at the Gyirong border port in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region.

recentItems.title: New Barrier Lake Forming 2.8km Downstream of Existing Landslide Dam on Chinese-Nepal Border
recentItems.description:
A new barrier lake has begun forming downstream of an existing landslide dam near the Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border after a fresh landslide struck on the night of August 29, the Ministry of Emergency Management said on August 30.

recentItems.title: Roads to Mudslide-Hit Areas Still Blocked, Hamper Rescue Efforts in Nepal
recentItems.description:
Roads on the Nepali side of the mudslide-hit areas remained severely blocked as of Aug 29, hampering rescue efforts after devastating flash floods and mudslides tore through the region on Aug 26.

recentItems.title: Xi Arrives in Kyrgyzstan for SCO Summit, State Visit
recentItems.description:
Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in Bishkek, the capital city of Kyrgyzstan, on the afternoon of August 30 for the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Summit 2026 and a state visit to Kyrgyzstan at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov. #Xijinping #ChinesePresident #Xi’sTime

recentItems.title: Rescuers Repair Critical Road Section to Mudslide-Hit Border Port
recentItems.description:
Rescuers on Aug 29 restored the first sharp-curve section on the national highway G216 -- where the roadbed had been completely destroyed -- preparing for full reopening of this critical lifeline to the mudslide-hit border port of Gyirong in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region.

recentItems.description:
